description: One day's food log from Garmin Connect: calories, carbs, protein and fat eaten against the daily goals (adjusted goals include active calories), then each meal with its logged foods. Food totals are per serving × servings. Only has meals if the user logs food in Garmin Connect.

date.description: Calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today in the user's time zone.

name: garmin_get_food_log
title: Get Garmin food log
